subject: Channel private offer readiness — CloudScale go-live checklist & invoice routing
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Emma Shaw <emma@cloudscalepartners.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@amazon.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Channel private offer readiness — CloudScale go-live checklist & invoice routing

Hi Emma and Ravi,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the CloudScale private offer. To keep momentum, I've attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a listing checklist so we can align on AWS acceptance steps, invoice flow, and timing.

High level ask: can CloudScale confirm whether you'll purchase under your reseller account or have the end customer (Acme Inc) submit the PO to you and then to AWS? That will determine invoicing flow and when we need the signed PO/DocuSign.

Attachments: CPPO-MAP-CloudScale-v1.pdf, AWS-Channel-Listing-Checklist.xlsx, Reseller-PO-template.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Emma: confirm billing path and provide reseller tax and remit info (by Thu 2/11)
- Ravi: confirm expected AWS acceptance window once invite is issued (by Fri 2/12)
- Redwood: we will prepare the listing assets and required attestation and loop in finance after Emma confirms billing path (owner: me)

If this plan looks right I'll route the MAP to each of you for signature.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Emma Shaw <emma@cloudscalepartners.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@amazon.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel private offer readiness — CloudScale go-live checklist & invoice routing

Avery,

Thanks — look good. Quick clarifying questions from our side:
1) We will submit the PO to us (CloudScale) from Acme, then we push it through the CPPO flow — so Redwood will bill AWS and we (CloudScale) will reconcile with Acme. Is that the right expectation?
2) Do you have a preferred PO template fields required for your finance team? We can pre-populate to speed the handoff.
3) Timeline: Acme would like a target go-live the week of 3/8. Is that realistic given AWS acceptance windows?

On the acceptance window, Ravi — any read on how long acceptance typically takes once CPPO is submitted? We want to make sure Acme’s date is feasible.

Best,
Emma Shaw
Partnerships Lead, CloudScale Partners
emma@cloudscalepartners.com | +1 (617) 555-2233

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel private offer readiness — CloudScale go-live checklist & invoice routing

Emma — thanks for the fast reply and the timeline. Answers inline:

1) Billing path: yes, your description is correct. CloudScale will invoice Acme and then you will be the reseller of record with AWS. Redwood will coordinate the listing and the customer-facing invoices will flow through CloudScale once the CPPO is accepted.

2) PO fields: attached is a short PO template our finance team prefers (Reseller-PO-template.pdf). Key fields we need: Redwood legal name, Redwood remit address, Redwood tax ID, line-item SKUs and period, billing contact name/email, and total contract value. If you can pre-fill and return, we can engage billing quickly.

3) Timeline: Ravi — based on previous runs we'd expect acceptance to be ~3–7 business days after AWS invites are issued and the CPPO information is complete. If Acme is targeting 3/8 go-live we recommend issuing the CPPO by the week of 2/22 at the latest to allow time for listing and acceptance.

I've uploaded the MAP to the HubSpot deal and added a checklist owner for each action. Once Emma confirms billing remit I'll route the MAP via DocuSign.

Regards,
Avery

Attachments: Reseller-PO-template.pdf, CPPO-MAP-CloudScale-v1.pdf

Avery / Emma — looping in finance ops details from our side so there are no surprises:

- Redwood preferred remit: Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94102
- Redwood tax ID: 94-1234567
- Please provide reseller remit name, tax ID, and billing email for invoicing (we need this before we push listing assets to AWS).
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default; if CloudScale needs Net 45 we need a written request with justification attached to the MAP.

Emma — if you can send the pre-filled PO and reseller remit info by EOD Thu 2/18 we can schedule a billing handoff meeting for 2/22.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
